events.title: Noosa Alive! Festival
events.description: A comprehensive arts and culture festival featuring theatre, ballet, literature, comedy, and film, with over 25 individual events spread across various locations in Noosa. It offers a wide range of creative and intellectual experiences.

events.title: Open Studios Sunshine Coast
events.datetime: Fri 17 Jul – Sun 26 Jul, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
events.location: Various artist studios and galleries across the Sunshine Coast
events.cost: Varies (access generally free, workshops may cost)
events.description: A unique opportunity to visit local artists in their creative spaces across the Sunshine Coast, view their work, purchase unique pieces, and possibly participate in hands-on art workshops. Features both coastal and hinterland studios.

events.title: "Sense of Place III" ACI Member Exhibition
events.datetime: Sat 18 Jul – Sun 2 Aug, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM daily
events.description: An exhibition by Arts Connect Inc. members at Mary Cairncross Scenic Reserve, exploring themes of perspective and place within the macro and micro, drawing inspiration from the local ecology. Artists are often present.

events.title: LORE and LAND First Nations artists in the Art Collection
events.description: An exhibition at Caloundra Regional Gallery showcasing works by First Nations artists, celebrating deep cultural knowledge, ancestral connections, and sovereign rights of Australian Indigenous peoples.

events.title: Caloundra Arts Centre Open Days 2026
events.datetime: Sat 25 Jul, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM & Sun 26 Jul, 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM
events.description: Celebrate the Caloundra Arts Centre's 50th anniversary with a family-friendly event featuring live art and craft demonstrations across various mediums, a fashion parade, and interactive make-and-take creative activities.
